I can't give you the letter for q3. I don't hand out quiz answers, and that includes practice retakes. Your two attempts haven't been graded yet, so the quiz is still open. I'm not trying to make this hard. A quiz only tells you something if the answer comes from you.

Here is a way to work it out yourself that treats every option the same. Take each of the four options and ask two questions:

1. Would this change anything about what the agent does on step 41?
2. Does it fix the cause of the problem, or does it only change something around the problem?

Write one sentence per option. Keep the stem in view, because it says exactly what the agent can already see and what it is doing. Then ask which option would still protect you if the same thing happened on a different bug you hadn't thought of. That fits your mission too. Your team has a small model budget, so ask what each option does to the cost of a run that goes wrong.

If you send me your one-line reasoning for each option, I'll tell you whether the reasoning holds up. I just won't point at a letter. Once the submissions are graded, we can go through q3 together, with the answer and the explanation. Grading both attempts is the next step, and I can do that now if you'd like.

Which of the four options do you find the most tempting, and why?
